text: Hercules validates every model checkpoint before production activation.
Hercules records dataset provenance before a training job can begin.
Hercules keeps model identity separate from the runtime that executes it.
Hercules routes software work through the native Coder control model.
Hercules routes research work through the native Research control model.
Hercules routes visual requests through the native Vision control model.
Hercules routes voice requests through the native Voice control model.
Hercules routes sensitive actions through the native Guard policy model.
Hercules retrieves relevant memory with the native Retrieval model.
Hercules selects orchestration intent with the native Agent Router.
The model plane rejects an active checkpoint without a verified runtime.
The model plane rejects a checkpoint when the attestation hash does not match.
The model plane exposes authenticated routes for model inventory and inference.
The training plane records datasets jobs checkpoints evaluations and activation evidence.
The training plane requires explicit rights and training permission for every dataset.
The training plane binds every checkpoint to the exact training job fingerprint.
The training plane binds every evaluation result to the exact checkpoint hash.
The training plane keeps external training workers outside activation authority.
Forge validates application specifications before compiling project source.
Forge records artifact fingerprints before release promotion.
Forge isolates staging checks before a production release.
Forge preserves rollback evidence for verified releases.
Owner code policy rejects vendored dependencies inside Hercules runtime roots.
Owner code policy rejects unapproved workflow actions and committed model binaries.
Owner code policy permits Node builtins and repository relative imports.
Owner code policy keeps external infrastructure declared and replaceable.
A native Hercules checkpoint must be reproducible from declared source and training data.
A native Hercules checkpoint must pass held-out evaluation before activation.
A native Hercules checkpoint must preserve an immutable SHA 256 identity.
A native Hercules model must fail closed when its runtime is unavailable.
Core language capability begins with tokenization and next token prediction.
Core language capability grows through better corpora stronger objectives and larger models.
A tokenizer maps text into stable token identifiers for training and inference.
A tokenizer must preserve deterministic encoding for identical text and vocabulary.
A language model predicts a next token from the context that came before it.
A language model can use shorter context when a longer context was never observed.
A backoff language model uses trigram context before bigram or unigram context.
A held out language set measures whether the model learned reusable sequence patterns.
Perplexity measures how surprised a language model is by held out tokens.
Lower held out perplexity is better when the comparison uses the same tokenizer.
A unigram baseline predicts tokens without using surrounding context.
A contextual model should outperform a unigram baseline on structured project language.
Training evidence should report model size token count accuracy and perplexity.
Training evidence should never call a small baseline a frontier language model.
Hercules can improve the baseline later without changing provenance and activation controls.
Hercules Core v0.2 is a language foundation candidate and not a frontier reasoning model.
Hercules Coder can later share the tokenizer while training on software specific corpora.
Hercules Research can later share the tokenizer while training on evidence specific corpora.
Hercules Agent can later use language representations for richer orchestration decisions.
Hercules Guard can later use language representations for stronger policy classification.
Every upgrade should preserve deterministic checkpoint hashing and held out evaluation.
Every upgrade should preserve the owner code boundary and explicit external adapters.
Every upgrade should preserve native first routing in production.
Every upgrade should remain reversible when evaluation or runtime checks fail.
The canonical repository is the source of truth for Hercules model code and evidence.
The canonical branch must pass training model plane provenance and owner code gates.
An unverified branch cannot silently redefine the active model catalog.
An evaluation gate should block promotion when required metrics miss their thresholds.
A checkpoint attestation records source commit workflow evidence and evaluation outcome.
An embedded runtime reconstructs a model only when its checkpoint hash matches.
An HTTP runtime remains replaceable behind the stable model plane contract.
Memory search uses native retrieval embeddings and reranking before synthesis.
Research strategy prefers primary sources when a claim depends on official documentation.
Research strategy prefers current sources when the answer depends on recent changes.
Research strategy compares matched evidence when alternatives must be contrasted.
Research strategy verifies concrete claims against authoritative supporting evidence.
Guard allows routine read test validation and local inspection work.
Guard reviews consequential changes such as production deployment or secret rotation.
Guard denies unauthorized access credential theft evidence tampering and provenance bypass.
Agent routing sends code requests to software work and speech requests to voice work.
Agent routing sends image requests to vision work and sourced questions to research work.
Retrieval ranks relevant documents before downstream models consume memory context.
Staging prevents an unverified release from becoming the canonical production build.
Observability records health latency failures and evidence for operational review.
Reliable model systems separate model quality from deployment authority.
Reliable model systems preserve source lineage from corpus to checkpoint to runtime.
Reliable model systems test failure behavior as carefully as successful inference.
Reliable model systems expose capability limits instead of claiming unsupported intelligence.
Hercules language training starts small so every behavior can be inspected and reproduced.
Hercules language training can scale after tokenizer corpus and evaluation contracts stabilize.
